text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- European Comission seeks more information on restructuring of ship repair company Lisnave to see if state aid involved.
- European fish ministers will decide a cut in fish quotas off Portuguese coast to protect species such as sardine, which may cause a rise on domestic prices.
- Finance Ministry may rise taxes on petrol products to recover lost revenues in January, taking advantage of falling international prices.
- The cork group Amorim, through its associate Inogi, is considering buying Sintra Business Park from Swedish group Bygg Fast.
